info.title: WhatsApp API
info.description: This API allows you to send templated messages via WhatsApp using pre-approved message templates. Messages are sent using registered WhatsApp business accounts. To use this API, you must have a valid API key and a valid WhatsApp business account.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: All API requests require your API credentials, you will find them once logged into your account on the SETTINGS page. Scroll down to API Settings to find your API key.

Template.description: Template details for the message content.

name.description:
The **exact name** of the WhatsApp template.

- **Format:** Lowercase, alphanumeric, underscores only.
- **Example:** `order_confirmation`
- **Must be pre-approved** in your WhatsApp Business account.

parameters.description:
The **dynamic values** to populate placeholdes in the template message.

- The number of parameters **must match** the template placeholders.
- Supports **text only** (strings). Other types (e.g., images, documents) are not allowed.
- **Example Usage:**
  - Template: `"Hello, {1}! Your order {2} has been shipped."`
  - Parameters: `["Tony", "#12345"]`
  - Final message: `"Hello, Tony! Your order #12345 has been shipped."`

locale.description: Optional locale for the template (e.g., en_US), if not provided, the default locale is `en`.

message.description: The message to send via SMS.

sender.description: Registered WhastApp sender number. - Must be in **international format** E.164 format (e.g., +14155238886). - Number must be registered with the WhatsApp Business API.

recipient.description:
Recipient phone number in international format.

- Must follow **E.164 format** (e.g., `+14155238886` for a US number).
- No spaces, dashes, or special characters.
- The recipient must **have an active WhatsApp account**.
- Ensure the recipient **has opted in** to receive WhatsApp messages.

content_type.description: Type of the message content (e.g., template).

sms_fallback.description: Optional sms fallback if WhatsApp cannot send to recipient.

message_ref.description:
A unique reference ID supplied by your system to track messages.

- **Maximum Length:** 500 characters.
- This `message_ref` will be included in webhook events, allowing you to correlate sent messages with received events.

**Example Usage:**
 - Sending a message with `message_ref: "order-12345"`
 - Receiving a delivery webhook containing `message_ref: "order-12345"`, confirming it was delivered.
Optional reference ID set by the user for the message.

sender.description: Registered WhatsApp sender number in international format.

recipient.description: WhatsApp recipient phone number in international format.

content_type.description: Type of the message content (e.g., template).

sms_fallback.description: Optional sms fallback if WhatsApp cannot send to recipient.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`) when the message was created on the server.

post.description: Sends a single templated message to a single recipient. Templates need to be registered and pre-approved by WhatsApp.
